text: Git is a version control system that helps developers track changes in their code. One of its most useful features is branching. A branch lets you work on new ideas without affecting the main code. Developers often create feature branches to build something new, like a login page. When the work is finished, they merge the branch back into the main project. Before merging, teams often open a pull request so others can review the changes. This workflow keeps the project organized and reduces mistakes. By using branches, merging, and pull requests together, teams can collaborate smoothly and keep their code safe.
